notes: Manual transcription from both provided Twilight menu photographs.
The kitchen is open until midnight, seven nights a week.

Items are flat speech-ready text, preserving prices, descriptions, options, and section notes. Runtime menu parsing remains deferred.

sections.name: Appetizers & Finger Food
items: Fried Mozzarella 13.00. Breaded fresh with house batter and served with marinara.
Chicken Strips Basket 13.75. Breaded with house batter and served with a side.
Buffalo Hot Wings 14.00. Tossed in house-made buffalo sauce with bleu cheese dressing.
A Basket of French Fries or Tater Tots 8.00.
Nachos 13. House-made tortilla chips, Tillamook cheddar, mozzarella and cotija cheese, onions, cherry tomatoes, jalapenos, topped with crema and salsa verde. Add marinated chicken 4.00.

sections.name: Salads
items: House Made Caesar 10.00. Crisp romaine lettuce, parmesan, garlic and butter toasted panko, lemon, tossed with house-made Caesar dressing. Add chicken or house-made bacon 4.00.

Cobb Salad 13 or 16; price options are not labeled on the menu. A classic salad topped with grilled or fried chicken, a hard boiled egg, house-made bacon lardons, tomatoes, bleu cheese crumbles, served with house-made bleu cheese dressing.

House Salad 10.00. Mixed greens topped with cherry tomatoes, onions, cucumbers, parmesan and croutons. Served with your choice of dressing. Add grilled or fried chicken 4.00 or 6.00; addition prices are not labeled on the menu.

sections.name: House Made Sausages
items: The CheddarWurst 11. A house-made CheddarWurst sausage served on a grilled brioche roll, spicy mustard on the side.
The Classic Scottie Dog 13.50. A house-made CheddarWurst served with grilled onions and charred jalapeno whipped cream cheese.

sections.name: Burgers
items: Section note: All burgers are ground in house with 100 percent American Wagyu beef. Sandwiches are served a la carte. Substitute an Impossible meatless patty for 1.
The Classic Cheese Burger 15.00. Tillamook smoked sharp cheddar, lettuce, tomato, onions, pickles and Duke's aioli. Add thick cut house-made bacon 4.00.
The Seattle Burger 16.75. Thick sliced bacon, charred jalapeno whipped cream cheese, grilled onions, lettuce, tomato and Duke's aioli.
Grilled Onion Burger 15. Thin sliced grilled onions, thick sliced smoked provolone cheese, lettuce, tomato and Duke's aioli.
Blue Cheese Bacon Burger 16. Danish blue cheese crumbles, house-made bacon, lettuce, tomato, onions and Duke's aioli.
Mama Melt 16. Mama Lil's peppers, grilled onions, Danish blue cheese crumbles, Duke's aioli, lettuce, red onions, tomatoes, served on grilled thick sliced Macrina potato bread.

sections.name: Sandwiches
items: Section note: All sandwiches are served a la carte.
Grilled Cheese Sandwich 10.00. Smoked sharp Tillamook cheddar, mozzarella, provolone and American cheese. Served on toasted thick cut Macrina potato bread.
The BLT 13.75. House-made thick cut apple smoked bacon, shredded romaine, tomatoes, Duke's aioli, served on toasted thick cut Macrina potato bread. Add avocado 2.00.
The Tejano Sandwich 14.00. House lime and chili marinated chopped chicken, grilled jalapeno, smoked provolone and cotija cheese. Served with lettuce, tomato and diced onions on a crispy roll.
Chicken Club 15.75. Grilled chicken breast with Tillamook cheddar, house-made bacon, aioli, tomato, lettuce, onion and avocado on Texas toast.
Buffalo Chicken Sandwich 15.00. Grilled chicken breast tossed in house-made buffalo sauce with lettuce, tomato, onion and bleu cheese dressing on a toasted bun.
Fried Chicken Sandwich 16.00. House breaded and fried chicken breast with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and aioli on a toasted bun.

sections.name: Sides & Sauces
items: Add a side 4.00. French fries, tater tots or salad.
Sauces 0.75. Ranch, bleu cheese, honey mustard, barbecue or Duke's aioli.
